claims.quote: If you go to Edinburgh today, you’ll see around one in twenty shops lying empty.
claims.statement: Around one in twenty shops in Edinburgh are lying empty.

claims.quote: But if you go to Dundee, it’s more likely one in five.
claims.statement: In Dundee it is more likely that one in five shops are lying empty.

claims.quote: A man in East Renfrewshire can live, as I understand, on average seven years longer than a man in Glasgow
claims.statement: A man in East Renfrewshire can on average live seven years longer than a man in Glasgow.

claims.statement: Around one in six young people in Scotland are not in education, employment or training.
The Prime Minister offers Scotland DWP devolution, a model of localised employment support.

claims.quote: So in a couple of weeks, the National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales
claims.statement: The National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales in a couple of weeks.

claims.quote: It’s also why I am working on a new deal for food and farming at the EU-UK Summit on the 20th of November.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister is working on a new deal for food and farming to be taken to the EU-UK Summit on 20 November 2026.

claims.quote: a defence sector that already supports 12,000 jobs here in Scotland
claims.statement: The defence sector already supports 12,000 jobs in Scotland.
